Study Team

You can contact lakhtakia@virginia.edu if you would like to reach out to the study team.



Tech Team

You can contact mr2an@virginia.edu if you are experiencing any technical issues. For best assistance, please include the following information in your email:
  • What device are you using (e.g., iPhone, Android phone)?
  • What operating system version are you using (e.g., iOS 26.6.1)?
  • What app version do you have (e.g., 1.9.8)?
